title: ip-geolocation-ipinfodb
author: Gorjan Petrovski
description: Tries to identify the physical location of an IP address using the IPInfoDB geolocation web service (http://ipinfodb.com/ip_location_api.php). There is no limit on requests to this service. However, the API key needs to be obtained through free registration for this service: http://ipinfodb.com/login.php
